name: Intuitive Surgical
description: Intuitive makes the da Vinci robotic surgery system and sells it to hospitals. The business is a razor-and-blade model: a system costs a hospital $0.7 million to $3.1 million (or is leased), and each operation then uses single-use instruments and accessories that wear out, plus a yearly service contract. Instruments and accessories were 60 percent of FY2025 revenue of $10.06 billion and services 16 percent; the system sale itself was only 25 percent. Revenue therefore follows the number of procedures performed (about 3.15 million da Vinci procedures in FY2025, up 18 percent), not just how many systems are sold. The US is 68 percent of revenue.

sub.name: Surgical and hospital devices and diagnostics

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC code is 3842 (Orthopedic, Prosthetic & Surgical Appliances & Supplies), from the EDGAR submissions record.

employees.note: About 17,021 full-time employees: about 2,288 in R&D and about 7,625 in manufacturing. FY2025 10-K

businessLines.name: Instruments and accessories
businessLines.how: Recurring consumables: each surgery uses instruments that expire or wear out, so revenue rises with procedures performed on the installed base, billed per instrument.
businessLines.description: Single-use and limited-life instruments and accessories used in each da Vinci procedure.

businessLines.name: Systems
businessLines.how: One-time capital sale of a system at $0.7M to $3.1M (generally including a year of service), or operating-lease payments spread over years; sold by a capital sales team to hospitals whose budgets and procedure volumes drive timing.
businessLines.description: da Vinci surgical systems (da Vinci 5, Xi, SP) sold or leased.

businessLines.name: Services
businessLines.how: Annual service contracts charged per installed system after the first included year, so it grows with the installed base.
businessLines.description: Service and maintenance contracts on installed systems.

brands.name: da Vinci Xi and Si (earlier generations)
